purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian commercial system handling boleto (bank slip) and bonificação (bonus/discount) voucher printing for sales operations, including nota fiscal (invoice) management
purpose.summary: This program (PY050090) manages the printing of boleto/bonificação canhoto (receipt stubs) for sales operations. It loads map data, invoice lists, and customer information, then allows selection and printing of payment vouchers. It interacts with multiple files including invoices, customers, payment conditions, and printers.

notable_features: $set compiler directives (htmlpp preprocessor, sourceformat free, constant)
REPOSITORY section with OO class references (EscreveJson, Utils)
external-form CGI input section with IDENTIFIED BY clauses
48 COPY statements for file-control and data division
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS despite online nature — uses proprietary web/CGI framework
REDEFINES on form input array (occurs limite-lista)
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 1378 lines. The $set sourceformat"free" directive contradicts the mechanical indicator of 'fixed' format and 279 long lines — likely free format with long lines. The program appears to be part of a Brazilian ERP/commercial system using a proprietary CGI-based COBOL web framework. The htmlpp preprocessor and external-form construct suggest Micro Focus or a compatible compiler. Program type classified as online-cics equivalent (web CGI) rather than batch.
